description:
Found by the fz-nml.8 builder: `i * 1.5` (int times float) on native always takes the generic arithmetic path, which boxes its result. fz-sc8.213 covers only the two-integer _ii externs; this is the mixed case. Coordinate with whoever builds fz-sc8.213 (same extern lowering in native_codegen/prim.rs).

Approved by the user 2026-11-17 (relayed by the JSON session). Census and probes: fz-nml.9 description (JSON session, develop 4a05ae2be; per 1000 steps interp/run/build).

comments.text: Cause found by the builder (PR #718): mixed integer/float arithmetic already returned a raw f64; the boxes came from native_block_param_reprs forcing RawF64 to ValueRef and declaring every non-entry block parameter i64, so float-float loops boxed too. Fix: block parameters take AbiValueRepr::for_ty and their Cranelift type from it; block_param_abi_value_repr deleted. Fixture 01706: 1-2 boxes/step on run/build -> 0 on all three paths; no pin moved. Retitled to match.

title: A float carried across a join stays a raw float on native
